dedupe_keys.name: material specific packaging volumes placed on the market in finland by industry 2020 extrapolated 2018 2024

description: This workbook estimates how much packaging of each material enters the Finnish market, including packaging that producer responsibility schemes do not capture, so that recycling rates can be calculated on a complete base. The producers are Henna Jylhä, Annika Johansson and Jani Salminen of the Finnish Environment Institute, who described the method in Waste Management in 2025 and the data in Data in Brief in 2026. Coverage is Finland, broken down by industry and by five materials, fibre, glass, metal, plastic and wood, and split into consumer and business packaging. The 2020 base year combines Extended Producer Responsibility reports with estimates from economic statistics for volumes outside those schemes, and figures for 2018 to 2019 and 2021 to 2024 are extrapolated from 2020 packaging intensities and inflation-adjusted turnover. The workbook is available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: years other than 2020 are extrapolations, and estimated non-reported volumes carry method uncertainty. Simulation uses: sizing collection and sorting capacity for packaging waste, testing recycling targets, and tracing which industries generate each waste stream. Related records: the Eurostat municipal waste statistics (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) and ODYM (model-odym) support national material flow analysis.
name: Material-specific packaging volumes placed on the market in Finland by industry (2020, extrapolated 2018-2024)
provider: Henna Jylhä, Annika Johansson and Jani Salminen (Finnish Environment Institute, Syke)
schema_summary: Packaging placed on the market by industry for five materials (fibre, glass, metal, plastic, wood), split into consumer and business packaging; 2020 accounts combining Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) reporting with estimates for unreported volumes from economic statistics; extrapolations for 2018-2019 and 2021-2024 using 2020 packaging intensities and inflation-adjusted turnover

sources.note: Creators Jylhä, Johansson, Salminen and the Finnish Environment Institute; CC BY 4.0; published 2026-05-06, updated 2026-08-04; workbook 'A dataset for material-specific packaging volumes in Finland, 2018-2024.xlsx'; industry-specific packaging accounts for 2020 for five materials, consumer versus business packaging; non-EPR volumes added with the method of Jylhä et al. 2025 (Waste Management 196, 42-50); extrapolated to 2018-2019 and 2021-2024; data article Data in Brief 68, 113082
